t2.thesis: ALAB enters earnings after a sharp ~33% one-month drawdown with a large 14.7% implied move, so the reaction is close to a coin flip with a slight lean from washed-out positioning offset by a history of falling after beats.
reasons: Base rate near 54% for AMC and ai_infra, but semis cluster is weaker at 48%, so the prior stays near 0.54
Stock is down about 33% in a month and about 52% from its 52w high after an AI selloff, so expectations are reset and the bar is lower
Strong fundamentals: revenue up 104% YoY, Q3 guide of $540-560M implying about 40% QoQ, and estimates revised up sharply over 90 days
Stock fell after the last 3 revenue beats, and implied move of 14.7% with IV about 1.9x realized vol prices in a lot, so beats are needed to rise
Entry is the open on report day, so the pre-earnings day move is partly captured by entry; the scored move is only the overnight gap
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guidance versus elevated buy-side expectations, particularly Scorpio ramp magnitude and gross margin, in the context of AI capex sentiment.

prior.from: D004 base rates: overall validation hit 0.542; AMC 0.538; ai_infra cluster 0.558 (n=43); semis 0.479 (n=434). Blend ~0.54.

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. The earnings date you mention (2026-11-03) is after today's date (2026-11-02), so that report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how Astera Labs (ALAB) stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Lowered by about 0.02 from 0.54 because of the pattern of post-beat declines, a high bar from a steep 90-day estimate revision, and the weak semis cluster; partly offset by the washed-out price.

theses.expected: Rise: beat and a guide well above consensus, with Scorpio ramp and optical/custom wins, triggers a relief rally from depressed levels.
theses.mechanism: Oversold, short-covering and reset positioning amplify a strong guide.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 guide is merely in line with whisper numbers or gross margin falls below 72%.

theses.expected: Fall: a beat that is already priced in, with margin dilution from hardware modules and warrants, leads to sell-the-news as in the last three prints.
theses.mechanism: Elevated expectations after a 90-day estimate revision and a high-multiple stock leave little room.
theses.wrong_if: Guidance implies a sequential acceleration beyond the roughly 40% in Q3.

theses.expected: Macro dominates: the AI-spend selloff continues or reverses in the overnight session, driving ALAB regardless of the print.
theses.mechanism: High beta to the Nasdaq and AI-capex headlines from other hyperscaler reports.
theses.wrong_if: The stock moves idiosyncratically versus peers like Credo after the print.

key_observations: Scorpio X-Series share of revenue and commentary on optical and custom products
Customer concentration and the Amazon warrant impact
Overnight Nasdaq and AI peer moves
